title: B7 direct scholarly semantic-relation response
description: Response schema for the B7 comparator baseline. Exactly one required field, 'relation', drawn from the four-value enum below, plus an optional free-text 'justification'. The enum and the property list are exhaustive: no further values or fields are permitted. See strengthening/baselines/b7_direct_relation/schema.py for the rationale.

relation.description: same_as: the two strings denote the same concept for harmonisation purposes, including ordinary spelling, formatting, singular/plural, and unambiguous acronym/expanded-form variants. broader: Keyword A denotes a concept broader in scope than Keyword B. narrower: Keyword A denotes a concept narrower in scope than Keyword B. other: they are distinct concepts and neither is a simple broader/narrower relation.

justification.description: Optional short free-text rationale. Never parsed as a numeric score.
